published_ranges._notes: Resin: virgin NatureWorks Ingeo PLA + modifiers. Product pages: 'Silk products require special print settings' - for best results 230C nozzle and 60C bed; extrusion width is critical for layer bond: a 0.40 mm nozzle must use 0.50-0.60 mm extrusion width. Bed 60 is that single recommended value, not a range. Density 1.25 and Tg are from the generic Atomic PLA SDS (covers all PLA-based filaments), not a silk-specific TDS.
